name: Boschi Arenas
source:
A butler who manages facility care (inside the palace). He has a rough personality, but he calmed down a bit as he became older. He dislikes being a person others can rely on, but he’s surprisingly good at taking care of others.

[Translated from [url=https://akunekoring.tumblr.com/post/639670363562835969/character-introduction-pv-boschi-arenas]official character PV[/url]]
